title: MR9A stage 1: B01-B06 + B02-B03
configuration: MACHINIST E5-MR9A PRO V1.2 (Q87), four 16 GB DDR4 DIMMs (64 GB)
observations: Built from two matching fresh full-chip reads; flashed with write verification and a separate exact full-chip readback.
User reports normal and cold boots behave normally and boot time is unchanged, at least so far.
Three post-flash Linux boots: installed DIMM capacity, physical-memory total and PCI inventory matched the baseline; EDAC counters zero; no matching machine-check or I/O errors.
memtester 4.7.1: four parallel locked 1 GiB allocations, all default patterns, one loop, all passed; EDAC counters stayed zero.
limits: Initial boot-compatibility evidence on one board. Exact timing and warm/cold cycle counts were not supplied. A four-pass offline Memtest86+ result was not reported. Does not prove repair of the original intermittent boot failure or validate other revisions, DIMM configurations or combinations.
